_comment: Sources captured 2026-11-09 between ~17:35Z and ~17:58Z via an HTTP fetch tool (see scripts/collect_courses/COLLECTION_LOG.md). retrieved_at uses 17:50Z for all catalog pages. 'content' holds verbatim excerpts as rendered to the fetcher.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Office of the Registrar — Catalog landing page
sources.content: guide.berkeley.edu/courses/compsci returned HTTP 302 to this page. Page links 'Undergraduate Catalog' -> https://undergraduate.catalog.berkeley.edu/ and states catalog links give access for 'the current academic year'. Class times: http://classes.berkeley.edu

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — COMPSCI 61A
sources.content: Prerequisite (as rendered, truncated): "MATH 1A (may be taken concurrently) or Math 10A or Math 16A. Complete any" | "Programming experience equivalent to that gained from a score of 3 or above on the Advanced Placement Computer Science exam." Credit restriction: "Students will receive no credit for COMPSCI 61A after completing COMPSCI 47A, COMPSCI 61AS, or COMPSCI W61A." Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — COMPSCI 61B
sources.content: Prerequisite: "COMPSCI 61A, COMPSCI 88, or ENGIN 7." Heading 'Complete ANY of the following Courses:' rendered with no items. Credit restriction: "Students will receive no credit for COMPSCI 61B after completing COMPSCI 61BL, or COMPSCI 47B." Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — COMPSCI 61C
sources.content: Prerequisite (rendered as two segments): "COMPSCI 61A" | "COMPSCI 61B or 61BL, or programming experience equivalent to that gained in 9C, 9F, or 9G." Credit restriction: none listed. Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — COMPSCI 70
sources.content: Prerequisite (rendered as two segments, middle appears truncated): "Sophomore mathematical maturity, and programming experience equivalent to that gained in 3" | "or the Advanced Placement Computer Science A course." Credit restriction: none listed. Units: 4.

sources.title: Berkeley EECS department course page — COMPSCI 162
sources.content: Prerequisites: "COMPSCI 61B, COMPSCI 61C, and COMPSCI 70." Units: 4. Page footer '© 2022 UC Regents'; lists schedules for Fall 2022 and Spring 2023. No catalog page for COMPSCI 162 was located in the current catalog during collection.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — COMPSCI 170
sources.content: Prerequisite: "COMPSCI 61B and COMPSCI 70." Heading 'Complete ALL of the following Courses:' rendered with no items. Credit restriction: none listed. Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — COMPSCI 186
sources.content: Prerequisite: "COMPSCI 61C or COMPSCI 47C" | "COMPSCI 47C may be taken as a co-requisite for transfer students." Heading 'Complete ANY of the following Courses:' rendered with no items. Credit restriction: "Students will receive no credit for COMPSCI 186 after completing COMPSCI W186." Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — COMPSCI 188
sources.content: Prerequisite: "COMPSCI 61A, COMPSCI 61B, and COMPSCI 70." Credit restriction: none listed. Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — COMPSCI 189
sources.content: Prerequisite: "MATH 53 and MATH 54; and COMPSCI 70 or consent of instructor." Department: Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences. Credit restriction: none listed. Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — DATA C8
sources.content: No formal prerequisite. Requirement note: "This course may be taken on its own, but students are encouraged to take it concurrently" | "with a data science connector course (numbered 88 in a range of departments)." Credit restriction: "Students will receive no credit for DATA C8\COMPSCI C8\INFO C8\STAT C8 after completing COMPSCI 8, or DATA 8." Formerly Computer Science C8, Statistics C8, or Information C8. Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — COMPSCI/DATA C88C
sources.content: Page displays COMPSCI C88C. No Prerequisite field. Credit restriction: "Students will receive no credit for DATA C88C after completing COMPSCI 61A." Former name: Computer Science 88. Units: 3.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — DATA/COMPSCI/STAT C100
sources.content: Page displays COMPSCI C100. Prerequisite (rendered as segments): "DATA C8 or STAT 20 with a C- or better, or Pass; and COMPSCI 61A, COMPSCI/DATA C88C, or ENGIN 7" | " with a C- or better, or Pass; Corequisite: MATH 54, 56, 110, ELENG 66, PHYSICS 89 or equivalent linear algebra" | " (C- or better, or Pass, required if completed prior to Data C100)." Credit restriction: "Students will receive no credit for DATA C100\STAT C100\COMPSCI C100 after completing DATA 100." Former name: Statistics C100/Computer Science C100. Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — DATA C102
sources.content: Prerequisite (rendered as segments): "Math 54 or 56 or 110 or Stat 89A or Physics 89 or both of ELENG 64 and ELENG 66 with a C- or better, or Pass;" | "Data/Stat/CompSci C100 with a C- or better, or Pass; and any of EECS 126, Data/Stat C140, Stat 134," | "IndEng 172, Math 106 with a C- or better, or Pass. Data/Stat C140 or EECS 126 are preferred". Department: Data Science Undergraduate Studies. Former name: Statistics 102. Credit restriction: none listed. Units: 4. Page is on graduate.catalog.berkeley.edu (same course ID system).

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — DATA C140
sources.content: Prerequisite (rendered as segments): "DATA/COMPSCI/INFO/STAT C8, or both STAT 20 and one of COMPSCI 61A or COMPSCI/DATA C88C with C- or better, or Pass;" | "and one year of calculus at the level of MATH 1A-1B or MATH 51-52 or higher, with C- or better, or Pass." | "Corequisite: MATH 54, MATH 56, ELENG 64, MATH 110 or equivalent linear algebra" | "(C- or better, or Pass, required if completed prior to enrollment in Data/Stat C140)." Credit restriction: "Students will receive no credit for STAT C140 after completing STAT 134, or EECS 126." Formerly Statistics C140. Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — DATA C182
sources.content: Prerequisite block (rendered as segments): "MATH 53, MATH 54, and COMPSCI 61B" | 'Complete ALL of the following Courses:' "COMPSCI 70 or STAT 134" | 'Complete ANY of the following Courses:' "COMPSCI 189 is recommended." | an empty 'Complete ALL of the following Courses:' heading. Credit restriction: "Students will receive no credit for COMPSCI 182 after completing COMPSCI W182, or COMPSCI L182." Formerly Computer Science 182. Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — EECS 126
sources.content: Prerequisite: "COMPSCI 70 preferred but not required." | 'Complete ALL of the following Courses:' heading followed only by "Familiarity with linear algebra." Credit restriction: none listed. Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — EECS 127
sources.content: Prerequisite: "ELENG 64 and ELENG 66, or consent of instructor." Heading 'Complete ALL of the following Courses:' rendered with no items. Credit restriction: none listed. Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — MATH 53
sources.content: Prerequisite: "MATH 52" | 'Complete ALL of the following Courses:' (no items rendered) | "Previously offered as 1B or N1B". Credit restriction: none listed. Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — MATH 54
sources.content: Prerequisite: "Mathematics 52 (previously 1B or N1B), 10B, or N10B." Credit restriction: "Students will receive no credit for MATH 54 after completing MATH H54, MATH N54, MATH W54, or MATH 56." Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — STAT 134
sources.content: Prerequisite: "One year of calculus." Credit restriction: none listed. Units: 4.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Catalog — STAT 135
sources.content: Prerequisite: "STAT 134 or STAT 140; and MATH 54, EL ENG 16A, STAT 89A, MATH 110 or equivalent linear algebra." | "Strongly recommended corerequisite: STAT 133." (spelling 'corerequisite' as on page). Credit restriction: none listed. Units: 4.
